assertions.name: convention_C_forms_still_match_the_recorded_C_sym
assertions.source: The three original (convention-C) forms against the recorded 2026-08-08 C-era sym. Gated so the historical claim stays falsifiable instead of becoming folklore — it is NOT compared against the live upstream, which is convention D.

description: Hecke-natural closed form for sym(Δtr_M)(q) under convention D: exact algebraic identity sym = -h·(q⁴-q⁻⁴)/8 = -h²·[2]_q·[2]_{q²}/8 with h = q-q⁻¹. The convention-C forms (-h·h̃/2 = -[2]_{q^(1/2)}·h̃²/2) are retained and still checked against the recorded C-era sym: the STRUCTURE — a product of two bar-antisymmetric Hecke quantities, hence bar-symmetric — survived the 2026-08-09 convention migration; only the second factor's argument (half-q → q⁴) and the constant (2 → 8) moved.
